# NovaPanel v1.6.145

- Restrict fleet configuration templates to outbound, route, and DNS configuration. Inbounds, users, and TLS identities remain local to each server.
- Keep legacy templates containing server-local identity data available for review and deletion, but block their preview and deployment.
- Create new inbounds through a separate fleet workflow. Each selected target gets a unique server/protocol tag, target-local TLS and subscription host, and all of its existing local users with enabled states preserved.
- Generate per-inbound secrets on each target. Do not copy source-server users, passwords, or TLS private keys. Aggregate nodes and aggregate subscriptions are unchanged.
